item.text: {"summary":"Evergreen flowering shrub or small tree native to southern Africa, from South Africa and Lesotho to Mozambique and Zimbabwe. It has showy bright yellow flowers and berry-like fruits that darken to brown or black around a pale, bone-coloured seed. Most varieties have woolly, dull, toothed oval leaves, while the rotundatum variety has glossy, round leaves.","humanEdibility":"unknown","edibilityNote":null,"evidence":{"summary":["s1:p1","s1:p2","s1:p7"],"humanEdibility":[]}}
